purpose: Validate the fixed Treasury 10-Year auction-demand signal and point-in-time mapping before any performance study.

fixed_signal.definition: For each auction after the first chronologically, compare bid_to_cover_ratio with the immediately preceding 10-Year Note auction. Positive change=+1, negative change=-1, unchanged=0.

pit_contract.information_timestamp: record_date, the official dataset publication date
pit_contract.action_rule: Map each event to the first eligible common trading date strictly after record_date.
pit_contract.terminal_event_rule: Events with no next trading date inside the fixed study window are recorded as terminal and are not silently dropped.
pit_contract.calendar_source: XNYS exchange session calendar via exchange_calendars; date-level session eligibility only
pit_contract.calendar_rule: first XNYS session strictly after record_date

coverage_contract.note: Asset OHLCV coverage is a separate later gate; Q019 validates event-source and PIT semantics only.

decision_rule: If the fixed source/signal/PIT contract passes, a separate performance preregistration may be considered. No performance evidence is created by Q019 itself.
